# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# CARRY_FOOD exclusions — items that passed the comestible_type=FOOD check but
# are semantically wrong for a Nemesis inventory.
# Most systematic patterns (mutant_, nether_, human_, egg_*, _active) are now
# filtered in the generator's _classify_food function.  Items below are one-off
# cases that do not match any reusable pattern.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

# --- Debug food items ---
debug_calories
debug_nutrition

# --- Venoms incorrectly classified as comestibles ---
# These items have comestible_type=FOOD in CDDA but are animal venoms, not food.
venom_bee
venom_paralytic
venom_wasp

# --- Cannibalism items whose IDs don't start with human_/demihuman_ ---
# The generator filter catches human_*/demihuman_* prefixes; these end with
# _human or embed it differently and need explicit listing.
fat_tainted_human
tainted_innards_human
pepperhuman
small_demihuman_stomach_boiled

# --- Tainted / ruined food ---
fat_tainted
tainted_innards
ruined_chunks
meal_bone
meal_bone_tainted

# --- Alien / nether food not caught by ID fragment filter ---
# alien_meadow_bush_2_fruit has no standard faction prefix.
# bone_mi-go uses a hyphen separator instead of underscore.
alien_meadow_bush_2_fruit
bone_mi-go

# --- Planting seeds (not ready-to-eat carry items) ---
# seed_lotus_boiled is kept — boiled lotus seeds are real food.
seed_eggplant

seed_potato_raw
seed_pumpkin
paste_seed

# --- Agricultural and fertilizer inputs ---
fert_supplement

# --- Brewing and fermentation inputs (not standalone food) ---

hops
malted_grain
yogurt_starter_culture
sourdough_starter_uncovered
